generationPrerequisites.notes: Full beta generation exposed the same two reference-deletion collisions already resolved by the reviewed v1.0 collision policy. Both profiles' published Remove-Mg(Beta)PrintShareAllowedGroupByRef and Remove-Mg(Beta)PrintShareAllowedUserByRef metadata records the collection $ref DELETE (including Delete/Delete1 variants). Extend only the existing exact item-DELETE suppressions to beta/no-data; retain collection GET/POST/DELETE. This is an explicit generation prerequisite, not an invented third shared directive or a new whole-collection suppression. Cross-path variant support remains subject to the existing reviewed policy.

DevicesCloudPrintDirectiveMigrationTests pins absence in all four documents and keeps unrelated print operations available.
